movies.overview: In post–civil war Spain, 10-year-old Ofelia moves with her pregnant mother to live under the control of her cruel stepfather. Drawn into a mysterious labyrinth, she meets a faun who reveals that she may be a lost princess from an underground kingdom. To return to her true father, she must complete a series of surreal and perilous tasks that blur the line between reality and fantasy.
movies.title: Pan's Labyrinth
movies.tagline: Innocence has a power evil cannot imagine.

movies.overview: A brilliant plastic surgeon creates a synthetic skin that withstands any kind of damage. His guinea pig: a mysterious and volatile woman who holds the key to his obsession.
movies.title: The Skin I Live In
movies.tagline: The things the love of a madman can do...

movies.overview: Three generations of women survive the east wind, fire, insanity, superstition and even death by means of goodness, lies and boundless vitality.
movies.title: Volver
movies.tagline: Return.

movies.overview: Following the tragic death of her teenage son, Manuela travels from Madrid to Barcelona in an attempt to contact the long-estranged father the boy never knew. She reunites with an old friend, an outspoken transgender sex worker, and befriends a troubled actress and a pregnant, HIV-positive nun.
movies.title: All About My Mother
movies.tagline: Part of every woman is a mother/actress/saint/sinner. And part of every man is a woman.

movies.overview: Grace is a religious woman who lives in an old house kept dark because her two children, Anne and Nicholas, have a rare sensitivity to light. When the family begins to suspect the house is haunted, Grace fights to protect her children at any cost in the face of strange events and disturbing visions.
movies.title: The Others
movies.tagline: Sooner or later they’ll find you.

movies.overview: A television reporter and cameraman follow emergency workers into a dark apartment building and are quickly locked inside with something terrifying.
movies.title: [REC]
movies.tagline: Experience fear.

movies.overview: Handsome 25-year-old Cesar had it all -- a successful career, expensive cars, a swank bachelor's pad, and an endless string of beautiful and willing women -- until he is thrown into a strange psychological mystery after a car accident scars his face and lands him in prison.
movies.title: Open Your Eyes

movies.overview: Two men share an odd friendship while they care for two women who are both in deep comas.
movies.title: Talk to Her

movies.overview: A woman brings her family back to her childhood home, which used to be an orphanage, intent on reopening it. Before long, her son starts to communicate with a new invisible friend.
movies.title: The Orphanage
movies.tagline: A tale of love. A story of horror.

movies.overview: Antoine and Olga, a French couple, have been living in a small village in Galicia for a long time. They practice eco-responsible agriculture and restore abandoned houses to facilitate repopulation. Everything should be idyllic except for their opposition to a wind turbine project that creates a serious conflict with their neighbors. The tension will rise to the point of irreparability.
movies.title: The Beasts

movies.overview: Spain, 1939. In the last days of the Spanish Civil War, the young Carlos arrives at the Santa Lucía orphanage, where he will make friends and enemies as he follows the quiet footsteps of a mysterious presence eager for revenge.
movies.title: The Devil's Backbone
movies.tagline: What is a ghost?

movies.overview: Ana, an eight-year-old girl living in Madrid with her grandmother and two sisters, mourns the death of her mother.
movies.title: Cria!

movies.overview: A playboy has the tables turned on him when he finds himself being used as a plaything by an undesirable woman.
movies.title: The Ferpect Crime

movies.overview: Salvador Mallo, a filmmaker in the twilight of his career, remembers his life: his mother, his lovers, the actors he worked with. The sixties in a small village in Valencia, the eighties in Madrid, the present, when he feels an immeasurable emptiness, facing his mortality, the incapability of continuing filming, the impossibility of separating creation from his own life. The need of narrating his past can be his salvation.
movies.title: Pain and Glory

movies.overview: When an old friend brings filmmaker Enrique Goded a semi-autobiographical script chronicling their adolescence, Enrique is forced to relive his youth spent at a Catholic boarding school.
movies.title: Bad Education

movies.overview: The Spanish Deep South, 1980. A series of brutal murders of adolescent girls in a remote and forgotten town bring together two disparate characters - both detectives in the homicide division - to investigate the cases.
movies.title: Marshland
movies.tagline: Life, Death, Redemption.

movies.overview: While working on a thesis about audiovisual violence, film student Ángela finds a snuff video where a girl is tortured until death. Soon she discovers that she was a former student in her university, and that the authors of the video are not very far either.
movies.title: Thesis
movies.tagline: My name is Ángela. They're going to kill me.

movies.overview: Un Chien Andalou is an European avant-garde surrealist film, a collaboration between director Luis Buñuel and Salvador Dali.
movies.title: Un Chien Andalou
movies.tagline: Once upon a time...

movies.overview: After being estranged for 15 years, flamboyant actress Becky del Paramo re-enters her daughter Rebeca's life when she comes to perform a concert.  Rebeca, she finds, is now married to one of Becky's ex-lovers, Manuel. The mother and daughter begin making up for lost time, when suddenly, a murder occurs...
movies.title: High Heels
movies.tagline: A mother, a daughter, a lover. Relationships can be murder.

movies.overview: Manuel, a Spanish politician whose high-class lifestyle is based on nefarious and illegal business threatens to break his entire party after a newspaper exposes him to the public eye. Rather than admit to any wrongdoing, he decides to sell out his whole party in an effort to avoid jail time. It's a decision that will put many lives at risk.
movies.title: The Realm
movies.tagline: Kings fall. Realms endure.

movies.overview: A slab of food descends down a vertical facility. The residents above eat heartily, leaving those below starving and desperate. A rebellion is imminent.
movies.title: The Platform
movies.tagline: There are 3 kinds of people; the ones above, the ones below, and the ones who fall.

movies.overview: César, an unhappy concierge, maintains a peculiar relationship with the very diverse inhabitants of the upper-class apartment building where he works in Barcelona.
movies.title: Sleep Tight
movies.tagline: Someone is watching over you

movies.overview: A trapeze artist must decide between her lust for Sergio, the Happy Clown, or her affection for Javier, the Sad Clown, both of whom are deeply disturbed.
movies.title: The Last Circus
movies.tagline: It's showtime

movies.overview: Injustice and the demands of the world can cause stress for many people. Some of them, however, explode. This includes a waitress serving a grouchy loan shark, an altercation between two motorists, an ill-fated wedding reception, and a wealthy businessman who tries to buy his family out of trouble.
movies.title: Wild Tales
movies.tagline: We can all lose control

movies.overview: Barcelona, Spain. Adrián Doria, a young and successful businessman accused of murder, meets one night with Virginia Goodman, an expert interrogation lawyer, in order to devise a defense strategy.
movies.title: The Invisible Guest
movies.tagline: Every story has two sides. The truth, only one.

movies.original_title: Mujeres al borde de un ataque de nervios
movies.overview: After being dumped by her lover, Pepa finds her life and the lives of those around her spiraling out of control in a deliciously chaotic series of events.
movies.title: Women on the Verge of a Nervous Breakdown
movies.tagline: A comedy about someone you know.

movies.overview: When a rogue priest discovers the exact date the Antichrist will be born, he enlists a Death Metal record store clerk and a cheesy TV psychic for an urban spree of gore, sacrilege and twisted humor to prevent the Apocalypse.
movies.title: The Day of the Beast
movies.tagline: A devilishly dark comedy.

movies.overview: 12-year-old Conor encounters an ancient tree monster who proceeds to help him cope with his mother's terminal illness and being bullied in school.
movies.title: A Monster Calls
movies.tagline: Stories are wild creatures.

movies.overview: Harry Caine, a blind writer, reaches this moment in time when he has to heal his wounds from 14 years back. He was then still known by his real name, Mateo Blanco, and directing his last movie.
movies.title: Broken Embraces
movies.tagline: Passion, obsession, wealth, jealousy, family, guilt, and creativity.

movies.overview: A selfish postman and a reclusive toymaker form an unlikely friendship, delivering joy to a cold, dark town that desperately needs it.
movies.title: Klaus
movies.tagline: A true selfless act always sparks another.

movies.overview: A black and white silent movie, based on the Snow White fairy tale, that is set in a romantic version of 1920s Seville and centered on a female bullfighter.
movies.title: Blancanieves

movies.overview: Madrid, summer 2011. Economic crisis. 15-M movement and 1.5 million pilgrims waiting for the Pope’s arrival live side by side in a Madrid that’s hotter and more chaotic than ever. In this context, detectives Velarde and Alfaro must find what seems to be a serial killer. Their against-the-clock hunt will make them realise something they’d never imagined: neither of them are so very different from the killer.
movies.title: May God Save Us

movies.overview: Ramón Sampedro is a ship mechanic and part-time poet left a quadriplegic following a diving accident. Ramón fought for 30 years for the legal right to end his own life. He develops close relationships with his long-term lawyer Julia and his friend Rosa, who tries to convince him that his life is worth living. Despite his situation, Ramón manages to inspire those around him to live life to the fullest.
movies.title: The Sea Inside

movies.overview: In 1940, in the immediate aftermath of the Spanish Civil War, a young girl living on the Castilian plain is haunted after attending a screening of James Whale's 1931 film Frankenstein and hearing from her sister that the monster is not dead, instead existing as a spirit inhabiting a nearby barn.
movies.title: The Spirit of the Beehive

movies.overview: A gang of gold thieves land in a coven of witches who are preparing for an ancient ritual... and in need of a sacrifice.
movies.title: Witching & Bitching

movies.overview: The film spans 30 years in Julieta’s life from a nostalgic 1985 where everything seems hopeful, to 2015 where her life appears to be beyond repair and she is on the verge of madness.
movies.title: Julieta

movies.overview: After being released from a mental hospital, a troubled young man tracks down an actress he once had sex with and forces her into captivity, determined to make her part of his life.
movies.title: Tie Me Up! Tie Me Down!
movies.tagline: A love story... with strings attached!

movies.overview: Viridiana is preparing to start her life as a nun when she is sent, somewhat unwillingly, to visit her aging uncle, Don Jaime. He supports her; but the two have met only once. Jaime thinks Viridiana resembles his dead wife. Viridiana has secretly despised this man all her life and finds her worst fears proven when Jaime grows determined to seduce his pure niece. Viridiana becomes undone as her uncle upends the plans she had made to join the convent.
movies.title: Viridiana
movies.tagline: We've got nothing to hide...

movies.overview: After finding an enormous amount of money hidden in a dead man's apartment, real estate agent Julia must face the wrath of the very peculiar inhabitants of the apartment building, who will stop at nothing to get their hands on the money.
movies.title: Common Wealth
movies.tagline: Love thy neighbor's… money

movies.overview: A historical drama set in Roman Egypt, concerning philosopher Hypatia of Alexandria and her relationship with her slave Davus, who is torn between his love for her and the possibility of gaining his freedom by joining the rising tide of Christianity.
movies.title: Agora
movies.tagline: Alexandria, Egypt. 391 A.D. The World Changed Forever.

movies.overview: On October 13, 1972, Uruguayan Air Force Flight 571, chartered to take a rugby team to Chile, crashes into a glacier in the heart of the Andes.
movies.title: Society of the Snow
movies.tagline: Based on a remarkable true story.

movies.overview: A man and his son arrive at a rave lost in the mountains of Morocco. They are looking for Marina, their daughter and sister, who disappeared months ago at another rave. Driven by fate, they decide to follow a group of ravers in search of one last party, in hopes Marina will be there.
movies.title: Sirāt

movies.overview: In December 2004, close-knit family Maria, Henry and their three sons begin their winter vacation in Thailand. But the day after Christmas, the idyllic holiday turns into an incomprehensible nightmare when a terrifying roar rises from the depths of the sea, followed by a wall of black water that devours everything in its path. Though Maria and her family face their darkest hour, unexpected displays of kindness and courage ameliorate their terror.
movies.title: The Impossible
movies.tagline: Nothing is more powerful than the human spirit.

movies.overview: A couple of English tourists arrive at the island of Almanzora, off the Spanish Mediterranean coast, where they discover that there are no adults in a small fishing village, only some children who stare at them and smile mysteriously.
movies.title: Who Can Kill a Child?
movies.tagline: Suddenly… They were the only adults left alive on the island

movies.original_title: Il buono, il brutto, il cattivo
movies.overview: While the Civil War rages on between the Union and the Confederacy, three men – a quiet loner, a ruthless hitman, and a Mexican bandit – comb the American Southwest in search of a strongbox containing $200,000 in stolen gold.
movies.title: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
movies.tagline: For three men the Civil War wasn't hell. It was practice.

movies.overview: The action continues from [REC], with the medical officer and a SWAT team outfitted with video cameras are sent into the sealed off apartment to control the situation.
movies.title: [REC]²
movies.tagline: Fear Revisited.

movies.overview: The story of two men on different sides of a prison riot -- the inmate leading the rebellion and the young guard trapped in the revolt, who poses as a prisoner in a desperate attempt to survive the ordeal.
movies.title: Cell 211
movies.tagline: To survive inside, he has to become one of them.

movies.overview: Trevor, an insomniac lathe operator, experiences unusual occurrences at work and home. A strange man follows him everywhere, but no one else seems to notice him.
movies.title: The Machinist
movies.tagline: How do you wake up from a nightmare if you’re not asleep?

movies.overview: Ten years have gone by since Elena's six-year old son has disappeared.  The last thing she heard of him was a phone call he gave her, saying that he was lost on a beach in France and couldn't find his father.  Nowadays, Elena lives on this same beach and manages a restaurant. She is finally beginning to emerge from this tragic episode when she meets a French teenager who strongly reminds her of her lost son.  The two of them will embark on a relationship which will sow chaos and distrust around them.
movies.title: Mother

movies.overview: A man accidentally gets into a time machine and travels back in time nearly an hour. Finding himself will be the first of a series of disasters of unforeseeable consequences.
movies.title: Timecrimes
movies.tagline: A trip back in time from the present to...

movies.overview: Paul is a U.S. truck driver working in Iraq. After an attack by a group of Iraqis he wakes to find he is buried alive inside a coffin. With only a lighter and a cell phone it's a race against time to escape this claustrophobic death trap.
movies.title: Buried
movies.tagline: 170,000 sq miles of desert. 90 minutes of oxygen. No way out.

movies.overview: Hoping to put to rest years of unease concerning a past case, retired criminal investigator Benjamín begins writing a novel based on the unsolved mystery of a newlywed’s rape and murder. With the help of a former colleague, judge Irene, he attempts to make sense of the past.
movies.title: The Secret in Their Eyes
movies.tagline: An unsolved crime. A love story. An unwritten ending.

movies.overview: Teenagers Birdboy and Dinki have decided to escape from an island devastated by ecological catastrophe: Birdboy by shutting himself off from the world, Dinki by setting out on a dangerous voyage in the hope that Birdboy will accompany her.
movies.title: Birdboy: The Forgotten Children
movies.tagline: There is light and beauty, even in the darkest of worlds.

movies.overview: When Victor attempts to seduce Elena, all he gets for his trouble is a one-way, six-year ticket to prison, where he concentrates on strengthening his mind, his body... and his desire for vengeance on the man who put him there. After his release and still madly in love with her, Victor will stop at nothing to win her over even if means revenge, for Elena has married David, the cop who sent him to prison!
movies.title: Live Flesh
movies.tagline: Life, love, desire... and everything in between.

movies.overview: After dumping a bucket of water on a beautiful young woman from the window of a train car, wealthy Frenchman Mathieu, regales his fellow passengers with the story of the dysfunctional relationship between himself and the young woman in question, a fiery 19-year-old flamenco dancer named Conchita. What follows is a tale of cruelty, depravity and lies -- the very building blocks of love.
movies.title: That Obscure Object of Desire
movies.tagline: Luis Buñuel's masterpiece

movies.overview: Julio Blanco is the proprietor of Básculas Blanco, a Spanish company producing industrial scales in a provincial Spanish town, which awaits the imminent visit from a committee that will decide if they merit a local Business Excellence award: everything has to be perfect when the time comes. Working against the clock, Blanco pulls out all the stops to address and resolve issues with his employees, crossing every imaginable line in the process.
movies.title: The Good Boss

movies.overview: Guillermo del Toro presents Mama, a supernatural thriller that tells the haunting tale of two little girls who disappeared into the woods the day that their parents were killed. When they are rescued years later and begin a new life, they find that someone or something still wants to come tuck them in at night.
movies.title: Mama
movies.tagline: A mother's love is forever.

movies.overview: Various lives converge on an isolated island, all connected by an author whose novel has become inextricably entwined with his own life.
movies.title: Sex and Lucía

movies.overview: Twenty-eight weeks after the spread of a deadly rage virus, the inhabitants of the British Isles have lost their battle against the onslaught, as the virus has killed everyone there. Six months later, a group of Americans dare to set foot on the Isles, convinced the danger has passed. But it soon becomes all too clear that the scourge continues to live, waiting to pounce on its next victims.
movies.title: 28 Weeks Later
movies.tagline: When days turn to weeks...

movies.original_title: Le Charme discret de la bourgeoisie
movies.overview: In Luis Buñuel’s deliciously satiric masterpiece, an upper-class sextet sits down to dinner but never eats, their attempts continually thwarted by a vaudevillian mixture of events both actual and imagined.
movies.title: The Discreet Charm of the Bourgeoisie

movies.overview: This is a story of a man in free fall. On the road to redemption, darkness lights his way. Connected with the afterlife, Uxbal is a tragic hero and father of two who's sensing the danger of death. He struggles with a tainted reality and a fate that works against him in order to forgive, for love, and forever.
movies.title: Biutiful
movies.tagline: You don't choose your family. We all belong to somebody, but to belong to Uxbal and Marambra, is both a blessing and a curse.

movies.overview: Somewhere in the Balkans, 1995. A team of aid workers must solve an apparently simple problem in an almost completely pacified territory that has been devastated by a cruel war, but some of the local inhabitants, the retreating combatants, the UN forces, many cows and an absurd bureaucracy will not cease to put obstacles in their way.
movies.title: A Perfect Day

movies.overview: Young Eva makes her decision to stay in Madrid for the month of August an act of faith. She needs to feel things differently and think of summer as a time of opportunity. On days of festivities and verbenas, while events and encounters take place, Eva will discover that she still has time, that an opportunity can still be given.
movies.title: The August Virgin
movies.tagline: To become your true self… How you become who you really are…?

movies.overview: As a director and his crew shoot a controversial film about Christopher Columbus in Cochabamba, Bolivia, local people rise up against plans to privatize the water supply.
movies.title: Even the Rain
movies.tagline: Many want to change the world... Few want to change themselves

movies.overview: Years after his mysterious disappearance, Julio Arenas, a famous Spanish actor, is back in the news thanks to a television program.
movies.title: Close Your Eyes

movies.overview: Two unmarried women who have become pregnant by accident and are about to give birth meet in a hospital room: Janis, in her late-thirties, unrepentant and happy; Ana, a teenager, remorseful and frightened.
movies.title: Parallel Mothers

movies.overview: A fatalistic car crash in Mexico city sets off a chain of events in the lives of three people: a supermodel, a young man wanting to run off with his sister-in-law, and a homeless man.
movies.title: Amores Perros
movies.tagline: Love. Betrayal. Death.

movies.overview: Something has gone wrong with the landing gear of a plane en route from Madrid to Mexico City. The group of eccentric travelers on the flight, defenseless in the face of danger, indulge in colourful confessionals, while the outlandish crew attempts to find ways to entertain them.
movies.title: I'm So Excited!

movies.overview: In downtown Madrid, a series of mysterious gunshots trap a motley assortment of people in a decrepit bar.
movies.title: The Bar
movies.tagline: Ordering coffee can cost your life

movies.overview: Seven candidates to a high executive position on a multinational company show up for a selection test in a skyscraper at the financial district. Among them, the most disparate personalities: the winner, the aggressive, the insecure, the critic, the indecisive…
movies.title: The Method
movies.tagline: When HR goes too far.

movies.overview: Laura, a Spanish woman living in Buenos Aires, returns to her hometown outside Madrid with her Argentinian husband and children. However, the trip is upset by unexpected events that bring secrets into the open.
movies.title: Everybody Knows
movies.tagline: Who did it?

movies.overview: Diego, a Venezuelan urbanist, and Elena, a contemporary dancer from Barcelona, move to the United States with their approved visas to start a new life. Their intention is to boost their professional careers and start a family in 'the land of opportunities'. But upon entering New York airport's immigration area, they are taken to the secondary inspection room, where border officers will subject them to an unpleasant inspection process and a psychologically grueling interrogation.
movies.title: Upon Entry

movies.overview: As a young woman, Tristana is orphaned and taken under the guardianship of Don Lope, a respected member of the community, who takes advantage of his innocent charge. When Tristana falls in love with artist Horacio, she must learn to be more assertive in order to achieve independence from her nefarious guardian, or her blossoming relationship with Horatio is doomed.
movies.title: Tristana
movies.tagline: Somewhere between the innocent girl and the not so innocent mistress is the bizarre, sensuous story of Tristana

movies.overview: The film centres on Moncho and his coming-of-age experience in Galicia in 1936. Moncho develops a close relationship with his teacher Don Gregorio who introduces the boy to different things in the world. While the story centres on Moncho's ordinary coming-of-age experiences, tensions related to the looming Spanish Civil War periodically interrupt Moncho's personal growth and daily life.
movies.title: Butterfly
movies.tagline: Stop and taste the world.

movies.overview: A young man and his three younger siblings are plagued by a sinister presence in the sprawling manor in which they live.
movies.title: Marrowbone
movies.tagline: No one will ever separate us.

movies.overview: Beautiful young housewife Séverine Serizy cannot reconcile her masochistic fantasies with her everyday life alongside dutiful husband Pierre. When her lovestruck friend Henri mentions a secretive high-class brothel run by Madame Anais, Séverine begins to work there during the day under the name Belle de Jour. But when one of her clients grows possessive, she must try to go back to her normal life.
movies.title: Belle de Jour
movies.tagline: Luis Bunuel's Masterpiece of Erotica!

movies.overview: Two girlfriends on a summer holiday in Spain become enamored with the same painter, unaware that his ex-wife, with whom he has a tempestuous relationship, is about to re-enter the picture.
movies.title: Vicky Cristina Barcelona
movies.tagline: Life is the ultimate work of art.

movies.original_title: บอดี้การ์ดหน้าเหลี่ยม
movies.overview: Wong, bodyguard to a tycoon, is fired by his boss's son after he fails to save his boss. Now, the assassins are after the son, who takes refuge in a slum. Wong, meanwhile, tackles the villain's goons.
movies.title: The Bodyguard
movies.tagline: Thailand's top bodyguard.

movies.overview: A conflicted youth confesses to crimes he didn't commit while a man and woman aroused by death become obsessed with each other.
movies.title: Matador

movies.overview: José Luis has a cushy corporate job at the lingerie factory his mom owns. After he falls in love and proposes to Silvia, a beautiful laborer on the underwear assembly line, his mom enlists Raul, a potential underwear model and would-be bullfighter, to seduce Silvia.
movies.title: Jamon Jamon
movies.tagline: A film where women eat men and men eat ham

movies.overview: The life of the bullfighter Andrés Roca Rey during a day of bullfighting, from the moment he dresses up to the moment he undresses.
movies.title: Afternoons of Solitude

movies.overview: The young but traveled Ana arrives in a manor in the countryside of Spain to work as nanny of three girls and finds a dysfunctional family.
movies.title: Anna and the Wolves

movies.overview: Julia, a woman suffering from a degenerative sight disease, finds her blind sister Sara hung in a basement. Despite all signs pointing to suicide, Julia decides to investigate what she intuitively feels is a murder case.
movies.title: Julia's Eyes
movies.tagline: You can't hide in the dark.

movies.overview: An ophthalmologist's assistant with an unhealthy interest in human eyeballs goes on a killing spree to collect eyeballs for his overbearing mother's collection. Reality soon takes a bizarre turn, both for the characters and the audience.
movies.title: Anguish
movies.tagline: The eyes of the city are mine.

movies.overview: A pair of newlyweds must fight to survive when their wedding reception descends into chaos and carnage when their guests become infected by a virus that turns them into hungry zombies.
movies.title: [REC]³ Genesis
movies.tagline: You may kiss the bride.

movies.overview: An army of bear cubs train and indoctrinate young recruits for the war against the unicorns, which threatens the safety of the cubs. Brothers Bluey and Tubby, along with a group of inexperienced cadets, are sent on a dangerous mission to save the Magic Forest, where the unicorns live, and start a terrible battle.
movies.title: Unicorn Wars
movies.tagline: Bear witness.

movies.overview: Tomás, who lives in Canada, travels to Madrid, Spain, to visit his old friend Julián. Both of them, accompanied by Truman, Julián's faithful dog, will share many surprising and emotional little moments, triggered by the hard situation Julián is going through, for just a few days.
movies.title: Truman
movies.tagline: Friendship is what matters in life

movies.overview: After a lavish dinner party, the guests find themselves unable to depart... and, over the next few days, all of their elaborate societal pretenses and façades deteriorate as they are reduced to living like animals.
movies.title: The Exterminating Angel
movies.tagline: The degeneration of high society!

movies.overview: Pablo, a successful film director, disappointed in his relationship with his young lover, Juan, concentrates in a new project, a monologue starring his transgender sister, Tina. Antonio, an uptight young man, falls possessively in love with the director and in his passion would stop at nothing to obtain the object of his desire.
movies.title: Law of Desire
movies.tagline: An Outrageously Funny Tale of Lust, Passion and Jealousy!

movies.overview: Prison inmate Miles Barrett is ripped awake in the middle of the night by a terrifying crash, gunfire, and the sickening screams of a man being torn apart. Something is loose in the prison - and it's coming for Miles...
movies.title: Inside
movies.tagline: Get out before it gets inside.

movies.overview: A group of juvenile delinquents live a violent life in the infamous slums of Mexico City; among them Pedro, whose morality is gradually corrupted and destroyed by the others.
movies.title: The Young and the Damned

movies.overview: A woman recalls her childhood growing up in the North of Spain, focusing on her relationship with her father.
movies.title: El Sur

movies.overview: An exploration —manipulated and staged— of life in Las Hurdes, in the province of Cáceres, in Extremadura, Spain, as it was in 1932. Insalubrity, misery and lack of opportunities provoke the emigration of young people and the solitude of those who remain in the desolation of one of the poorest and least developed Spanish regions at that time.
movies.title: Land Without Bread

movies.overview: While searching for a solution to his serious health condition, David, a renowned neurosurgeon, discovers a sinister secret hidden in the past.
movies.title: Painless
movies.tagline: Pain is their medicine

movies.overview: Island of Tahiti. French government official De Roller is a calculating man with impeccable manners, capable of dealing with both high society and the locals he frequents in shady joints.
movies.title: Pacifiction

movies.overview: A desperate photographer who suffers from a degenerative eye disease and a husband who wants to kill his dying wife, plot to recover her life insurance.
movies.title: Mirage

movies.overview: The mutilated body of a six year old girl is found in a water hole. The girl is identified as the missing daughter of Claudia. However, only two peices of evidence could be used to identify her; a bracelet with her name on it near the crime scene, and the fact that her right leg was three inches longer than her left. All other methods of identification were removed from her body. Five years later Claudia, now addicted to tranquilizers, receives a phone call from someone claiming to be her daughter, asking for her mother to come find her before 'they' kill her. Other mysterious clues show up, further indicating that Claudia's daughter is indeed still alive, and very much in danger. Claudia, a run-down ex-cop, and a parapsychology reporter put together the clues to discover Angela's whereabouts
movies.title: The Nameless
movies.tagline: Trying to reach the limits of evil... But evil has no limits.

movies.overview: When a billionaire entrepreneur impulsively decides to create an iconic movie, he demands the best. Renowned filmmaker Lola Cuevas is recruited to mastermind this ambitious endeavour. Completing the all-star team are two actors with massive talent but even bigger egos: Hollywood heartthrob Félix Rivero and radical theatre actor Iván Torres. Both are legends, but not exactly best friends. Through a series of increasingly eccentric trials set by Lola, Félix and Iván must confront not only each other but also their own legacies. Who will be left when the cameras finally start rolling?
movies.title: Official Competition
movies.tagline: The best director, the best actors, the best idea?

movies.overview: Almería, Tabernas desert, Spain, 2002. Texas Hollywood is a dilapidated and dusty town where Western movies have not been shot for decades. Julián Torralba and his partners, veteran film stuntmen, survive there, recreating pathetic action scenes for the pleasure of the few foreign tourists who visit the isolated region.
movies.title: 800 Bullets
movies.tagline: Let the battle begin…

movies.overview: An undertaker gets married to an old executioner's daughter and, although he doesn't like it, must continue the profession of his father-in-law after his retirement.
movies.title: The Executioner
movies.tagline: An original and brilliant movie
